description: Hyperliquid auto-deleveraging (ADL) fills, newest first, across all markets or one: profitable positions Hyperliquid closed to cover a liquidation its backstop could not absorb. Per fill: wallet, market, side, price, size, notional, realized PnL, trade id (shared with the liquidated side) and transaction hash. Recorded from 2026-08-01; the default window is the last 7 days. For the liquidated side use get_liquidations.

market.description: Optional market filter: BTC-PERP or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, xyz:NVDA)

name: get_auto_deleveraging

tid.description: Trade id, shared with the liquidated side

notice.description: A note from the API: how a market name was read, why data starts later than asked, or a next step such as a free key

title: Auto-deleveraging fills
